records.subject: AFC–TGC hybrid system
records.object: Maximum power density: 295.80 versus 247.07 W m−2; 19.72% increase
records.quote: A mathematical model of the AFC-TGC hybrid system is established, taking into account the three overpotential losses in AFCs and the irreversible heat losses in TGCs.
context_quotes: Based on this thermal -electric coupled model, we investigate the hybrid system's output performance characteristics and optimal parameter design.
